Definition: from G25; beloved:--(dearly, well) beloved, dear.
BiblicalUsage: Agapetos is 'beloved' — the word for someone dearly loved. The Father speaks it over Jesus at His baptism, 'This is my beloved Son'; Paul writes to the beloved of God at Rome; he tells the Ephesians to walk in love as beloved children; and John warns his beloved not to believe every spirit. The word is used of Christ, of churches, and of individual believers — all of them held dear by the same love.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word is the gospel in a single adjective. To be beloved is not something I earn — the Father called Jesus beloved before He had done a single miracle, and He calls His children beloved in Christ, before they have done anything to deserve it.
RelatedTopics: Love of God; Identity in Christ; Grace; Assurance
